prs.testInstructions:
## Run & verify (already built)
1. Launch: C:\PowerToys-cf06\x64\Debug\PowerToys.exe
2. Open Keyboard Manager, open the editor, choose the Run Program action, and click the program-path browse button and the start-in browse button while PowerToys is elevated.
3. Verify the Windows file and folder dialogs open and selected paths populate the corresponding fields.
4. Repeat with Cancel and with a non-elevated run; verify no crash and that existing typed paths remain unchanged.
